summary: Firefly Neuroscience (AIFF) filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of a securities purchase agreement (dated May 6, 2026) with an accredited investor for up to 666,667 units at $1.50/unit ($1M gross proceeds). The termination was effective June 25, 2026, per Section 5.3. No termination fee, penalty, or implication for existing operations was disclosed. The filing relates solely to the cancellation of a capital-raising commitment, not an M&A transaction, activist campaign, or restructuring. As a routine termination of a financing agreement, it does not constitute a special situation.
